items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So going back to Dizzy. Did you ever encounter his band? Was it ’47 with Chano Pozo and that? [INTERVIEWEE] I saw them on 52nd Street, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was great. I think Jug was still on the band, Gene Ammons, but Flap was the man for me.
So going back to Dizzy. Did you ever encounter his band? Was it ’47 with Chano Pozo and that?
I saw them on 52nd Street, yeah.
